serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
…
So that’s DAK…
He came up to me slowly, with some kind of pistol in his hand…
DAK: We finally met face to face.
DAK: You piece of shit, it’s all because of you that my great plan is useless now!
DAK: I had so much planned, I only needed some help and we would finally make a change. Something would actually change for once! 
DAK: It’s because of fucking idiots like you why our great country went to shit! No one cares until it’s too late! Until they don’t have enough money to put food on their tables! 
DAK: You know what’s the difference between me and you?
You: …
DAK: ANSWER ME! {{punch}}
You: I don't know…
DAK: The difference is that I will not allow for something as ambiguous as ‘morals’ to stop me from achieving my goal.
DAK: I wish I at least knew what Admin looks like so I could kill him too, but your death will need to suffice to calm my anger. 
DAK: Any last words?
You: …
You: Please…{{wi}} Don’t do this…
DAK: Ha! {{wi}}I knew you were pathetic! DIE!
